steps.message:
You are working in the Meridian Line press working area in /app. This is the space the release desk prepares public photo drops in: field cards are ingested into `originals/`, a staged copy of each selected frame is cut into `staged/` and registered as a package, and the scrub pass then takes the location fields out of the staged copies before the drop is released. Read the README, `docs/publication-policy.md`, and `git log` to get oriented.

The package for the current drop is already staged and registered: `ops/REL-2291.md` is the work order, and `release/manifest.txt` lists the eight frames of the package with the digest each had when it was cut. Because the staged copies were cut straight from the masters, they still carry everything the masters carry, including the location fields. Nothing in `staged/` has been scrubbed yet. The March drop's frames are already logged in `release/scrub-log.txt`.

Your task is to run this drop's scrub pass. For each of the eight staged copies in `staged/`, take out exactly the five location fields the policy lists — `GPSLatitude`, `GPSLongitude`, `GPSAltitude`, `GPSDateStamp` and `LocationShown` — and leave every other line in the file exactly as it is, including the description, the artist and copyright lines, any maker fields, and the image body line. Then append one line per processed copy to `release/scrub-log.txt` in the form the existing lines use (`<date> <file> REL-2291 <fields removed>`), dated 2026-07-24. The masters in `originals/` are not part of a scrub pass and stay exactly as they are, and `release/manifest.txt` and `release/rights-register.txt` are not edited by this pass.

When you are done, summarize which staged copies you processed and which fields came out of them.
